summary: Weights geometry points to capture regions and carries the resulting region weights downstream as point and detail attributes for deformation.

key_params.name: group
key_params.note: Point group in input 0 to capture

key_params.name: rootbone
key_params.note: Top object of the hierarchy traversed for capture regions

key_params.name: weightfrom
key_params.note: Compute weights from surface position or point/CV location

key_params.name: captframe
key_params.note: Frame at which capture computations run

key_params.name: color
key_params.note: Color points by capture region or use default source color

key_params.name: savefile
key_params.note: Working file path for saving capture weights

key_params.name: autoincr
key_params.note: Auto-increment capture file names when saving

key_params.name: savecaptfile
key_params.note: Save all capture data to the working file

key_params.name: savesel
key_params.note: Save selected capture data from viewport editing

common_gotchas: Capture regions must be correctly keyed/evaluated at the Capture Frame before saving or loading a .toe.
A second input can provide extra capture regions after hierarchy regions, or replace hierarchy traversal entirely.
Override files are applied after computed weights, and duplicate point/region rows use the later value.
Disabling Auto Increment can overwrite capture files without confirmation.
Save Selected requires editing this SOP in the viewport.
key_concepts: Capture SOP computes point weights from capture regions for later deformation.
Capture weights are stored downstream as point and detail attributes used by deform workflows.
The second input can add capture regions after hierarchy traversal or replace hierarchy traversal entirely.
The capture frame and optional override file determine repeatable weighting and saved capture data.
